declarations.description:
A searchable list of commands: a search field above `c2-command-item` rows, optionally sorted into
`c2-command-group`s and split by `c2-command-separator`s. Typing filters the rows (every word of the query must appear in
a row's label, `value` or `keywords`), hides the groups left without a match and shows the `empty` slot when nothing
matches. Put it in a `c2-modal` for a ⌘K palette, or inline in a page or a popover.

Focus never leaves the search field. Arrow Up/Down move the highlight between the enabled matching rows (wrapping
with `loop`), Enter activates the highlighted row and a click activates the clicked one. Activation fires
`command-select`; a row with `href` then navigates unless the event was cancelled. The field is a `combobox` whose
`aria-activedescendant` tracks the highlighted `option`.

Set `manual-filter` when the rows come from a server: the palette then shows every row, and the app filters on
`input` (read `query`) and replaces the rows.
declarations.name: Command

declarations.description:
One command of a `c2-command` palette. The palette filters rows against the query, highlights one of them and
activates it on Enter or a click; the row itself never handles the keyboard and never takes focus, which stays in the
palette's search field. The default slot is the label, `description` a second muted line, `prefix-icon` /
`suffix-icon` take an inline SVG or an icon element, and `shortcut` holds a keyboard hint (plain text or a `c2-kbd`).

The row matches when every word of the query appears in its label, its `value` or its `keywords`. With `href` the
row is a link: activating it navigates unless the palette's `command-select` event is cancelled.
declarations.name: CommandItem

members.name: value
members.description: The value reported in `command-select`, also matched against the query. Defaults to the label text.

members.name: keywords
members.description: Extra words the query matches, separated by spaces or commas (synonyms, ids, tags).

members.name: disabled
members.description: Dims the row; it can be matched but never highlighted or activated.

members.name: href
members.description: Makes the row a link that activating it navigates to.

members.name: target
members.description: Browsing context used when `href` is set, such as `_blank`.

members.name: data
members.description: Arbitrary payload returned alongside `value` in `command-select`. Not an attribute.

members.name: active
members.description: Set by the palette on the highlighted row. Announced as `aria-selected`.

members.name: filtered
members.description: Set by the palette while the row does not match the query; the row is then not rendered.

members.name: label
members.description: The label text: what the palette matches and what `value` falls back to.

members.name: resolvedValue
members.description: The value reported when the row is activated: `value`, or the label text when `value` is empty.

members.name: searchText
members.description: Lower-cased text the palette matches: label, value and keywords.

members.name: navigate
members.description: Follows `href`, as a click on the row would. The palette calls it after `command-select` was not cancelled.

declarations.description:
A labelled group of `c2-command-item` rows inside a `c2-command`. The palette hides the whole group, heading
included, while none of its rows matches the query.
declarations.name: CommandGroup
